capabilities: Preview the current note as it will appear on a target platform
Apply themes and light/dark styles to the formatted output
Copy styled HTML for pasting into the WeChat public-account editor
Copy clean Markdown for pasting into the X Articles editor
Configure a default platform, themes, and an image host URL in settings
extras: Runs entirely offline with no account or upload service; README notes that vault-local images do not carry over to X and must be uploaded there or served from a configured image host. The manifest says the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert notes into the styled or cleaned-up format required by editors like WeChat public accounts and X Articles, so writers must reformat manually.

relations.evidence: Styled article you can paste into the WeChat public-account editor
Clean Markdown you can paste into the X Articles editor

summary: Formats Markdown notes into styled, copy-ready content for WeChat public accounts and X Articles with a live preview and themes.
